description: Show an object's feature values and what its behaviors are doing (%features): the values its attributes hold, the objects its parts and ports hold, its connectors, and the state of each machine it exhibits and action it performs. Objects come from repl_command `%instantiate <name>` or from runs.

all.description: expand every nested object; overrides depth

depth.description: expand nested objects to this depth without a size bound; omit for the prompt's bounded listing

object.description: an object the session holds: its name, #id, or a path such as car.fl or #1.wheels[2]

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: features

graph.description: the object and everything reachable from it as the runtime API's Instantiate writes it (opensysml.v1 JSON); absent when the build does not link the graph writer

text.description: the listing as %features prints it: each feature's value and what the object's behaviors are doing
